headline: Sources: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane suffered torn ACL vs. Chiefs
summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday's loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the rest of the 2026 season, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Giants Fear Brian Burns Suffered ACL Tear
summary: The Giants may have been dealt a massive blow on defense during yesterday’s win. Edge rusher Brian Burns is feared to have suffered an ACL tear, ESPN’s Adam Schefter and NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport report. headline: Sources: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn out indefinitely with torn quad
summary: Panthers cornerback Jaycee Horn will seek a second opinion on his torn quad, sources told NFL Network, but he is headed for injured reserve and could miss the rest of the 2026 season.

headline: McCarthy exits Vikings as one of franchise's biggest draft busts
summary: J.J. McCarthy was the No. 10 pick in 2024 but played only 10 games before being traded to the Giants on Monday.

headline: Buccaneers' Mayfield (thumb) out at least three weeks, Bowles says
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is expected to miss at least three weeks with the dislocated thumb on his throwing hand he suffered Sunday, coach Todd Bowles announced Monday.

headline: What's driving the Browns' 2-1 start?
summary: Daniel Oyefusi discusses the impact of Deshaun Watson and the Browns' offense as Cleveland leads the AFC North.
